candidates.requirement: For the parsers it creates and parses, the target must make the supported explicit 16-byte hash-salt setup reachable before parsing.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates parent and namespace parsers and, later, two possible external parsers. ParseOneInput always calls XML_SetHashSalt with one unsigned-long value before XML_Parse.
candidates.failure_condition: For finite accepted XML such as <a/> and a 16-byte entropy value with a nonzero first key word, the target has no setup that can select that value; the legacy setter sets the first word to zero.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete entry and helper show no XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes call or alternate setup. Automatic salt generation cannot select a specified 16-byte value, and external parsers inherit the parent's setup.
